ExternalRiskEstimate.label: External risk estimate
ExternalRiskEstimate.description: Consolidated risk score from the credit bureau (higher is better).

MSinceOldestTradeOpen.label: Months since oldest account opened
MSinceOldestTradeOpen.description: How long ago the oldest credit account was opened.

MSinceMostRecentTradeOpen.label: Months since newest account opened
MSinceMostRecentTradeOpen.description: How long ago the most recent credit account was opened.

AverageMInFile.label: Average months in file
AverageMInFile.description: Average age of all credit accounts, in months.

NumSatisfactoryTrades.label: Satisfactory accounts
NumSatisfactoryTrades.description: Number of accounts in good standing.

NumTotalTrades.label: Total accounts
NumTotalTrades.description: Total number of credit accounts on file.

NumTradesOpeninLast12M.label: Accounts opened in last 12 months
NumTradesOpeninLast12M.description: New credit accounts opened in the past year.

PercentInstallTrades.label: Percent instalment accounts
PercentInstallTrades.description: Share of accounts that are instalment loans (0 to 100).

PercentTradesNeverDelq.label: Percent never late
PercentTradesNeverDelq.description: Share of accounts that have never been late (0 to 100).

NumTrades60Ever2DerogPubRec.label: Accounts ever 60+ days late
NumTrades60Ever2DerogPubRec.description: Accounts ever 60 or more days late, or with a derogatory public record.

NumTrades90Ever2DerogPubRec.label: Accounts ever 90+ days late
NumTrades90Ever2DerogPubRec.description: Accounts ever 90 or more days late, or with a derogatory public record.

MSinceMostRecentDelq.label: Months since last late payment
MSinceMostRecentDelq.description: Months since the most recent late payment.

MaxDelq2PublicRecLast12M.label: Worst delinquency, last 12 months (code)
MaxDelq2PublicRecLast12M.description: Bureau code for the worst delinquency in the last 12 months (0 to 9).

MaxDelqEver.label: Worst delinquency ever (code)
MaxDelqEver.description: Bureau code for the worst delinquency ever (2 to 8).

MSinceMostRecentInqexcl7days.label: Months since last credit inquiry
MSinceMostRecentInqexcl7days.description: Months since the most recent credit check, ignoring the last 7 days (0 to 24).

NumInqLast6M.label: Inquiries in last 6 months
NumInqLast6M.description: Number of credit checks in the last 6 months.

NumInqLast6Mexcl7days.label: Inquiries in last 6 months (excl. last 7 days)
NumInqLast6Mexcl7days.description: Credit checks in the last 6 months, ignoring the last 7 days.

NetFractionRevolvingBurden.label: Revolving balance ratio (%)
NetFractionRevolvingBurden.description: Card and revolving balances divided by their limits, in percent.

NetFractionInstallBurden.label: Instalment balance ratio (%)
NetFractionInstallBurden.description: Instalment balances divided by the original loan amounts, in percent.

NumRevolvingTradesWBalance.label: Revolving accounts with a balance
NumRevolvingTradesWBalance.description: Number of cards or revolving accounts that carry a balance.

NumInstallTradesWBalance.label: Instalment accounts with a balance
NumInstallTradesWBalance.description: Number of instalment loans that still carry a balance.

NumBank2NatlTradesWHighUtilization.label: Bank/national accounts with high use
NumBank2NatlTradesWHighUtilization.description: Bank or national cards used above 75% of their limit.

PercentTradesWBalance.label: Percent accounts with a balance
PercentTradesWBalance.description: Share of all accounts that carry a balance (0 to 100).
